name: Titan Intech Limited
about: Titan Intech Limited provides digital transformation for IT infrastructure and business data in India. It provides Digital Learning through computer-based training, internet-based training, web-based training modules, as well as involved in creation of 2D graphics and advanced 3D animations. The company was formerly known as Indovation Technologies Limited and changed its name to Titan Intech Limited in June 2016. Titan Intech Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
